### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,

the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

  Sí. Tenemos experiencia internacional en múltiples sectores y adaptamos la estrategia a cada caso,
  tanto para empresas que arrancan como para grandes cuentas. En la primera consulta estudiamos tu
  situación en detalle.

  Por supuesto. Cada servicio funciona de forma independiente, aunque los resultados se multiplican
  cuando se combinan con analítica y una estrategia común.
* ### ¿Cómo sé que está funcionando?
  
  Con datos. Es nuestra esencia (Ari-metrics): implementamos una medición fiable y te damos informes
  claros con la evolución de tráfico, posiciones, conversiones y retorno. Sin estimaciones ni cajas
  negras.
* ### ¿Cuánto cuesta y cómo empezamos?
  
  Cada proyecto es personalizado, así que el primer paso es una consulta gratuita en la que
  analizamos tu caso y te proponemos un plan a medida, sin compromiso.
* ### ¿Dónde estáis y con quién trabajáis?
  
  Estamos en Madrid (C. del Ferrocarril, 18) y trabajamos con clientes de toda España y proyectos
  internacionales.

## Vora - AI Health Coach for Workouts, Nutrition, Recovery & Meditation

Vora is the all-in-one AI health coach for iPhone. It combines personalized AI workout plans, photo
nutrition logging, recovery tracking, guided meditation, cycle tracking, and voice-first coaching in
a single app. Used by 1,000+ athletes and busy professionals.

## AI-Powered Workout Plans

Get personalized training programs generated by AI based on your goals, fitness level, schedule, and
daily recovery. Choose from 6 distinct AI coach personalities. Progressive overload is tracked
automatically.

## Photo Nutrition Logging

Snap a photo of any meal and Vora's AI instantly identifies the foods and provides a full macro and
micronutrient breakdown - calories, protein, carbs, fat, and 35+ nutrients. No manual entry
required. Barcode scanning also available.

## Recovery Tracking & Vora Health Score

A daily 0-100 composite recovery score based on HRV, resting heart rate, sleep quality, and strain.
Vora recommends training intensity based on your recovery state to prevent overtraining.

## Voice-First AI Coaching

Powered by ElevenLabs conversational AI. Log workouts, meals, and health data entirely by voice. Ask
your coach questions, request a meditation session, or get a daily plan - all hands-free on iPhone
and Apple Watch.

## Guided Meditation & Mindfulness

Voice AI-guided meditation sessions on demand. Breathing exercises and mindfulness routines
accessible by voice command on iPhone or Apple Watch.

## Cycle Tracking

Track period, fertility window, ovulation, and symptoms. Workout recommendations automatically adapt
to your menstrual cycle phase for optimized performance and recovery.

## AI Daily Planning

A smart daily timeline with proactive suggestions for workouts, meals, hydration, and rest - adapts
to your calendar, recovery state, and goals.

## Apple Watch & 500+ Integrations

Native Apple Watch app with Live Activities, haptic timers, and voice logging. Connects with Apple
Health, Garmin, Oura, WHOOP, Fitbit, Strava, MyFitnessPal, Peloton, and 500+ more platforms.

## Pricing

Vora is free to download. Vora Pro is $12.99/month or $89.99/year ($7.50/month). Every new user
receives a 7-day free trial of Pro. No commitment required.

## Frequently Asked Questions

*Is Vora free to use?*
  Yes. Vora offers a generous free tier with core features including AI workout plans, basic
  nutrition logging, and recovery tracking. Vora Pro ($12.99/month or $89.99/year) unlocks unlimited
  voice coaching, advanced analytics, AI daily planning, and all 6 coach personalities. Every new
  user gets a 7-day free trial of Pro.
*What devices does Vora work with?*
  Vora is available on iPhone (iOS 14.0+) and Apple Watch. It syncs with Apple Health and integrates
  with 500+ fitness platforms including Strava, Garmin, Oura, Fitbit, WHOOP, and MyFitnessPal.
*How does Vora's AI nutrition logging work?*
  Take a photo of your meal and Vora's AI instantly identifies the foods and logs detailed
  nutritional information including calories, protein, carbs, fats, and 35+ micronutrients. You can
  also scan barcodes or use voice commands to log food hands-free.
*Is my health data private and secure?*
  Vora never sells your data or uses it for advertising. Your health data is encrypted at rest and
  in transit. HealthKit data is used exclusively for coaching, never for marketing or shared with
  third parties.
*How is Vora different from other fitness apps?*
  Most fitness apps focus on one thing: tracking workouts OR counting calories OR meditation. Vora
  is the only app that combines AI workout programming, photo nutrition logging, recovery and HRV
  tracking, guided meditation, cycle-aware training, and voice coaching in one unified experience -
  replacing 5-6 separate apps.
*Can Vora replace my personal trainer?*
  Vora provides personalized AI coaching that adapts to your goals, schedule, fitness level, and
  recovery status - similar to how a personal trainer would. It programs workouts with progressive
  overload, adjusts based on your performance, and provides real-time voice coaching during
  sessions.
*Does Vora support cycle tracking?*
  Yes. Vora tracks period, fertility, ovulation, and symptoms, and automatically adjusts workout
  recommendations based on your cycle phase for optimized performance.
*Is Vora available on Android?*
  Vora is currently available on iOS (iPhone 8+, iOS 14.0+). Android support is on the roadmap.

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Nimble Gravity Acquires Fog Solutions, further enabling client growth through data and AI

Tony Aug
August 11, 2025
4 min read

**DENVER and BOSTON; August 11, 2025** – *Nimble Gravity*, a global consultancy specializing in AI,
data, and software engineering,has acquired *Fog Solutions*, a premier data and AI firm recognized
fo rits expertise in Microsoft Azure and Databricks and its rapid delivery of AI-enabled and cloud
data solutions.

This acquisition brings 50 additional data and AI experts—primarily based in the U.S.—into Nimble
Gravity’s growing global team,bringing the firm’s global headcount to ~250.

Serving both corporate clients and private equity investors seeking to accelerate AI adoption and
technology-driven growth and efficiencies across their portfolios, Nimble Gravity specializes in
embedding data and AI into core business strategies while delivering the technical infrastructure
and solutions to execute transformational initiatives.  

Fog Solutions is known for its strong client outcomes, agile delivery model, and strategic
partnerships across the data ecosystem, including deep ties with Microsoft and Databricks.

“AI innovation continues to accelerate, organizations need trusted partners to help harness that
innovation for tangible business benefit,”said Tony Aug, Nimble Gravity’s CEO. “With the addition of
Fog Solutions,Nimble Gravity is better positioned to help clients unlock the full value of their
data, from helping define their data and AI strategy through execution.”

“Joining Nimble Gravity allows us to bring our velocity and technical depth to a broader client base
while continuing to deliver the high-quality outcomes our customers and partners expect,” said Matt
Jackson, CEO of Fog Solutions. “Together, we can help organizations realize the full promise of
artificial intelligence, starting with a robust data strategy, built with modern engineering, and
governed responsibly.”

Fog Solutions’ capabilities span the full data value chain,from strategy and governance to
architecture and AI product delivery,strengthening Nimble Gravity’s ability to serve clients across
industries, and creating the combined capabilities to deliver across Microsoft’s Cloud and AI
Platforms.

Earlier this year, Nimble Gravity received a strategic growth investment from Rallyday Partners, a
Denver-based investment firm that provides an alternative to traditional private equity for founders
who want to go even further, elevate entire industries, and share in the experience of a lifetime.
This marks Nimble Gravity’s third acquisition, following its recent integrations of *iGerencia*, a
Colombia-based data consultancy, and *mDEVZ*,an Argentina-based digital and data science firm.

“Fog Solutions brings not only exceptional technical talent but also a like-minded culture focused
on delivering client impact” said Nancy Phillips, Managing Partner at Rallyday Partners. “Their
track record in building scalable, cloud-native solutions aligns with the growing demand we’re
seeing from clients and will position Nimble Gravity to continue leading the way in AI-driven
strategy and execution.”

 

**About Nimble Gravity**
Founded in 2019, Nimble Gravity is a global consultancy specializing in data and AI-led business
transformation. The firm provides strategy, data science,digital engineering, and technology design
services across industries, helping clients unlock growth and operational excellence.  Headquartered
in Denver, Colorado, Nimble Gravity also has offices in Mexico City, Guadalajara, Buenos Aires, and
Medellín. More information is available at www.nimblegravity.com.

Tony Aug
August 11, 2025

**DENVER and BOSTON; August 11, 2025** – *Nimble Gravity*, a global consultancy specializing in AI,
data, and software engineering,has acquired *Fog Solutions*, a premier data and AI firm recognized
fo rits expertise in Microsoft Azure and Databricks and its rapid delivery of AI-enabled and cloud
data solutions.

This acquisition brings 50 additional data and AI experts—primarily based in the U.S.—into Nimble
Gravity’s growing global team,bringing the firm’s global headcount to ~250.

Serving both corporate clients and private equity investors seeking to accelerate AI adoption and
technology-driven growth and efficiencies across their portfolios, Nimble Gravity specializes in
embedding data and AI into core business strategies while delivering the technical infrastructure
and solutions to execute transformational initiatives.  

Fog Solutions is known for its strong client outcomes, agile delivery model, and strategic
partnerships across the data ecosystem, including deep ties with Microsoft and Databricks.

“AI innovation continues to accelerate, organizations need trusted partners to help harness that
innovation for tangible business benefit,”said Tony Aug, Nimble Gravity’s CEO. “With the addition of
Fog Solutions,Nimble Gravity is better positioned to help clients unlock the full value of their
data, from helping define their data and AI strategy through execution.”

“Joining Nimble Gravity allows us to bring our velocity and technical depth to a broader client base
while continuing to deliver the high-quality outcomes our customers and partners expect,” said Matt
Jackson, CEO of Fog Solutions. “Together, we can help organizations realize the full promise of
artificial intelligence, starting with a robust data strategy, built with modern engineering, and
governed responsibly.”

Fog Solutions’ capabilities span the full data value chain,from strategy and governance to
architecture and AI product delivery,strengthening Nimble Gravity’s ability to serve clients across
industries, and creating the combined capabilities to deliver across Microsoft’s Cloud and AI
Platforms.

Denver-based investment firm that provides an alternative to traditional private equity for founders

strategy and execution.”

  wellness tracking. It works with Fitbit, Pixel Watch and other compatible trackers, syncing data
  from fitness apps, smart scales, glucose monitors and more.

* What can you do with Google Health?
  The Google Health app brings together your fitness, sleep, and health data from wearables and apps
  to give you a holistic view of your health and wellness in one place. With a Premium membership,
  you get an AI coach built with Gemini that gives you workout plans that adjust based on how
  recovered you are, helps you find out how much sleep your body needs, and answers questions about
  nutrition or what your metrics mean.^{1, 2}

  cost. There's also a Premium membership available that unlocks proactive coaching and
  personalisation across fitness, sleep and health.¹

## How It Works

##### How to Distribute Your Apps in 3 Simple Steps

#### Upload Your Build:

Simply drag and drop your IPA (iOS) or APK (Android) files into our secure uploader. We handle the
heavy lifting of preparing the manifest files required for wireless installation.

#### Generate a Secure Link:

Once the upload is complete, you’ll receive a unique, shortened URL. You can share this via email,
Slack, or WhatsApp with your team or testers.

#### Install Over-the-Air (OTA):

Testers just tap the link on their mobile browser to begin the installation immediately. No cables,
no iTunes, and no manual file transfers required.

## Why Choose InstallOnAir?

##### The Professional Choice for App Deployment

#### For Mobile Developers:

Use InstallOnAir as your primary TestFlight alternative. Get your builds into the hands of QA
testers instantly, bypassing lengthy store review processes during the early stages of development.

#### For Digital Agencies:

Impress your clients by providing a professional, branded portal for previewing app progress. Our
platform ensures your beta app distribution is seamless and secure.

#### For Enterprise Teams:

Manage internal employee apps with ease. Our infrastructure is optimized for enterprise-level
deployment, ensuring that your organization’s tools are always accessible to your workforce.

## Don’t want to waste time
## getting your apps to testers?

Are setups, reviews and processing times
upsetting your performance?

Don’t Worry there's an Enhanced Way!
Use InstallOnAir.com to distribute and install
your app over the air swiftly!

[JUST TRY IT NOW!][6]

## Our services

We offer one of the top platforms with best ready services for Beta App, iOS App and Android App
Distribution. Our app developers and experts can also provide multiple enterprise-level and tailored
services like consulting and research on application development, deployment of platforms,
development of new personalized features, technology support on your source code, setup of delivery
environments, technical support on even non-business days, even development of new web or mobile
application and more.

[Contact us][7]

## What people are saying

"We've been using InstallOnAir.com and we've got to say that it's the simplest way to share your
apps with colleagues. Check them out."

- Tom Townsend

“Thanks InstallOnAir.com for saving my work time. This is way better.”

- Steve Kneen

“We have initiated using Intall On Air for an upcoming project, happy using it so far.”

- Michael S.

# Frequently Asked Questions

[ What file types does InstallOnAir support? ][8]
We fully support .ipa files for iOS and .apk files for Android. Our system automatically generates
the necessary plist files for iOS OTA (Over-the-Air) installation.
[ Is there a limit to the file size I can upload? ][9]
We offer generous upload limits to accommodate everything from lightweight utility apps to heavy,
asset-rich mobile games.
[ How secure is my application data? ][10]
Privacy is our priority. Your files are hosted on secure servers, and links can be set to expire or
be deleted manually whenever you choose, ensuring your intellectual property remains protected.
[ Can I use this for production apps? ][11]
InstallOnAir is designed primarily for beta testing and internal distribution. For public release,
we recommend using the official Apple App Store or Google Play Store.

# Interaction Design for Trusted Sharing of
# Personal Health Data to Live Well with HIV

INTUIT was funded by [EPSRC][20] (2018 – 2022) to investigate how people with HIV may use their
personal data to support the management of their condition in daily life, for living and ageing
well.

We explored sharing this data with health and care providers, with peers, and with others, for HIV
self-management and self-care. We also researched perspectives from clinicians, public health
professionals, people with other long-term conditions, and other stakeholders, delivering evidence
to inform care provision.

This website is a resource for sharing information about the INTUIT studies and findings, plus
stories about public engagement and impact.

[Digital Economy Logo] [UKRI Logo]

Illustration: C. Claisse

# Stories from our research community

From the outset, the INTUIT team has aimed to develop responsible practices for conducting
technology research collaboratively with the intended ‘end users’ of designs. Listen to stories from
those directly involved in and impacted by the INTUIT research.

# Ant Babajee

Reflections by Ant Babajee (he/him), Advisory Board member.

Ant Babajee's Story

# Becky Walker

Reflections by Becky Walker (she/her), Engagement Officer (Blue Sky Trust).

Becky Walker's Story

Explore more INTUIT research stories
][21]

# Abigail Durrant

## INTUIT Project Lead, Newcastle University

“It has It has been an honour to work with the INTUIT team and partners over the last four years to
co-produce a research programme illuminating the lived experience of individuals with HIV. Drawing
upon a diversity of ‘co-creative’ methods, studies have evidenced unmet needs and desires relating
to self-managing the condition in daily life. We have aspired to gain multiple perspectives, across
the UK, on challenges and opportunities of working with digital tools and with personal data to
support HIV self-management and self-care, which gained new significance during the COVID-19
pandemic. We hope the research evidence can help inform the design of future systems and services
for whole-person wellbeing.”

# Shiraaz Sidat

## Peer Researcher, Terrence Higgins Trust

“Working on the INTUIT Research Project, as Peer Researcher, was truly phenomenal. I was able to
utilise my research skill set, gained via my MSc in Health Psychology, alongside learning about new
research methods. In addition to this, I was encouraged to develop leadership skills within
multidisciplinary research team. A key highlight for me was leading on an Abstract submission for
the AIDS 2022 Conference which accepted for publication alongside a poster presentation. I was also
able to attend the Conference in-person via a Scholarship award as well as funding via INTUIT. I
will always be grateful for my time working on such a superb research project.”

# Interaction Design for Trusted Sharing of
# Personal Health Data to Live Well with HIV

INTUIT was funded by [EPSRC][20] (2018 – 2022) to investigate how people with HIV may use their
personal data to support the management of their condition in daily life, for living and ageing
well.

We explored sharing this data with health and care providers, with peers, and with others, for HIV
self-management and self-care. We also researched perspectives from clinicians, public health
professionals, people with other long-term conditions, and other stakeholders, delivering evidence
to inform care provision.

This website is a resource for sharing information about the INTUIT studies and findings, plus
stories about public engagement and impact.

[Digital Economy Logo] [UKRI Logo]

Illustration: C. Claisse

# Stories from our research community

From the outset, the INTUIT team has aimed to develop responsible practices for conducting
technology research collaboratively with the intended ‘end users’ of designs. Listen to stories from
those directly involved in and impacted by the INTUIT research.

# Abigail Durrant

## INTUIT Project Lead, Newcastle University

“It has It has been an honour to work with the INTUIT team and partners over the last four years to
co-produce a research programme illuminating the lived experience of individuals with HIV. Drawing
upon a diversity of ‘co-creative’ methods, studies have evidenced unmet needs and desires relating
to self-managing the condition in daily life. We have aspired to gain multiple perspectives, across
the UK, on challenges and opportunities of working with digital tools and with personal data to
support HIV self-management and self-care, which gained new significance during the COVID-19
pandemic. We hope the research evidence can help inform the design of future systems and services
for whole-person wellbeing.”

# Shiraaz Sidat

## Peer Researcher, Terrence Higgins Trust

“Working on the INTUIT Research Project, as Peer Researcher, was truly phenomenal. I was able to
utilise my research skill set, gained via my MSc in Health Psychology, alongside learning about new
research methods. In addition to this, I was encouraged to develop leadership skills within
multidisciplinary research team. A key highlight for me was leading on an Abstract submission for
the AIDS 2022 Conference which accepted for publication alongside a poster presentation. I was also
able to attend the Conference in-person via a Scholarship award as well as funding via INTUIT. I
will always be grateful for my time working on such a superb research project.”

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable

  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Digital Technology and Public Health

 

### *Our vision is a world where technology serves our needs without undermining our physical,
### psychosocial or environmental health.*

## [Health Effects of Digital Technology][97]

### [Executive Summary: Wireless Technology and Public Health][98]

Digital and wireless devices have provided many benefits, however, we are now realizing that the
rapid adoption of this novel technology has not been accompanied by adequate regulation, monitoring
or safety precautions.

Widespread use of digital media and near constant exposure to wireless device electromagnetic field
emissions (EMFs) has caused increasing concern among scientists, health care professionals,
psychologists, educators and the public who are now considering this is not only a public health
issue but a looming public health crisis. (11,108) It appears that we are at the same point of
emerging science similar to early recognition of health impacts associated with tobacco, asbestos,
coal dust and lead. (119) These concerns are amplified by industry proposals for a massive expansion
of wireless infrastructure and connectivity.

### [Challenges for Physicians][102]

It seems impossible to many physicians that non-ionizing radiation from wireless devices would cause
physical symptoms or biological harm. Patient reported health concerns are often dismissed as
coincidence (e.g. cell phone use and brain cancer), or psychological (e.g. someone reporting
electrosensitivity symptoms near devices), or stress related (e.g. a couple that is infertile). 
There also seems to be endless controversy surrounding adverse health effects from wireless devices.
Physicians want to help patients and not give them incorrect advice or fan their fears.  After all,
one cannot see, hear or feel electromagnetic radiation. People must be “a bit off” to think effects
could be caused by electronic gadgets we have used for years, right? Well, as it turns out, there is
an  abundance of research from credible, unbiased sources which indicates clear harm from microwave
radio frequency radiation we are exposed to.

[Read More “Challenges for Physicians”][103]

### [Psychosocial Issues and Digital Technology Use][106]

Emotional well-being and positive human interaction are crucial for healthy individuals, healthy
families, and a healthy society. Researchers are finding that the overuse of interactive devices
such as computers, cell phones, video games, and other mobile electronic devices can have a direct
effect on our well-being and mental health. (5,19) With excess technology use, mental health experts
are reporting psychological and physiological effects on the central nervous system, especially in
children, leading to impairment of physical and mental functioning. Psychiatrists and psychologists
are seeing a disquieting rise in tech addiction, cyberbullying, depression, insomnia, loss of
empathy. and impaired social-emotional learning in their young patients. (1,3,10) )  Internet game
overuse has been found to have psychological and neural effects similar to other types of impulse
control disorders and addictions which are both substance

## [Health Effects of Digital Technology][97]

### [Executive Summary: Wireless Technology and Public Health][98]

Digital and wireless devices have provided many benefits, however, we are now realizing that the
rapid adoption of this novel technology has not been accompanied by adequate regulation, monitoring
or safety precautions.

Widespread use of digital media and near constant exposure to wireless device electromagnetic field
emissions (EMFs) has caused increasing concern among scientists, health care professionals,
psychologists, educators and the public who are now considering this is not only a public health
issue but a looming public health crisis. (11,108) It appears that we are at the same point of
emerging science similar to early recognition of health impacts associated with tobacco, asbestos,
coal dust and lead. (119) These concerns are amplified by industry proposals for a massive expansion
of wireless infrastructure and connectivity.

### [Challenges for Physicians][102]

It seems impossible to many physicians that non-ionizing radiation from wireless devices would cause
physical symptoms or biological harm. Patient reported health concerns are often dismissed as
coincidence (e.g. cell phone use and brain cancer), or psychological (e.g. someone reporting
electrosensitivity symptoms near devices), or stress related (e.g. a couple that is infertile). 
There also seems to be endless controversy surrounding adverse health effects from wireless devices.
Physicians want to help patients and not give them incorrect advice or fan their fears.  After all,
one cannot see, hear or feel electromagnetic radiation. People must be “a bit off” to think effects
could be caused by electronic gadgets we have used for years, right? Well, as it turns out, there is
an  abundance of research from credible, unbiased sources which indicates clear harm from microwave
radio frequency radiation we are exposed to.

[Read More “Challenges for Physicians”][103]

### [Psychosocial Issues and Digital Technology Use][106]

Emotional well-being and positive human interaction are crucial for healthy individuals, healthy
families, and a healthy society. Researchers are finding that the overuse of interactive devices
such as computers, cell phones, video games, and other mobile electronic devices can have a direct
effect on our well-being and mental health. (5,19) With excess technology use, mental health experts
are reporting psychological and physiological effects on the central nervous system, especially in
children, leading to impairment of physical and mental functioning. Psychiatrists and psychologists
are seeing a disquieting rise in tech addiction, cyberbullying, depression, insomnia, loss of
empathy. and impaired social-emotional learning in their young patients. (1,3,10) )  Internet game
overuse has been found to have psychological and neural effects similar to other types of impulse

][142]

[Learn More >][143]

##### Why MGMA?

## Advance the business of healthcare today for a better tomorrow

95+ㅤ

Years of achieving medical practice excellence.

60k+ㅤ

Medical practice administrators, executives, and leaders.

350k+

Physicians represented at more than 15,000 group medical practices ranging from small private
medical practices to large national health systems.

We believe the future is what you make it, and we’re here to support the people who are ready to
make the world a better place. See what your peers are saying about us!

> This was my first time attending an MGMA conference. I will definitely sign up to attend next
> year. There was so much valuable information/practices shared. The networking was incredible. I
> loved the experience!

###### Marquita H.

> This conference exceeded my expectations! MGMA is dominating content delivery in the virtual
> space. Very impressive!

###### Estari A.

> Our MGMA consultant gave us the perspective we needed to isolate and correct our problems as a
> practice. The good, bad and ugly came out, and we saw where and how to manage an effective plan of
> change. We all profited in revenue enhancement and management of the office.

###### Peter M.

> Working with MGMA is easy and stress free and we always see results. We feel like we've built a
> great working relationship with them that allows us to maximize every opportunity to deliver
> exceptional content and engage their members in meaningful ways to help us build our brand and
> effectively reach healthcare organizations that can benefit from our solutions.

###### Lea C.

## Celebrating Excellence in Medical Group Practices

**National Medical Group Practice Week** is celebrated annually during the last week of January.
It's a time to recognize the professionals who keep medical group practices running every day...

As part of our celebration in 2026, MGMA profiled three influential healthcare leaders at different
stages of their careers. Come explore their career journeys and be inspired!

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

# **OnyeOne API Documentation**[#][76]

The **OnyeOne API** provides a comprehensive interface to access, manage, and interact with
electronic health record (EHR) and electronic medical record (EMR) data. The API is designed to
support healthcare applications in ensuring interoperability, compliance with standards like FHIR,
and seamless integration into clinical workflows.

## **Key Features**[#][77]

**Patient Data Management**: Access and update patient demographics, medical history, and more.
**Appointment Management**: Schedule, update, and retrieve patient appointments, including details
such as date, time, provider, and location.
**Encounters**: Retrieve and manage patient encounters, including notes and diagnoses.
**Medications and Allergies**: Query prescribed medications, active allergies, and related details.
**Lab Results**: Retrieve lab orders, results, and observations.
**FHIR Compatibility**: Compliant with FHIR R4 specifications for enhanced interoperability.
**Secure Access**: OAuth 2.0-based authentication and role-based data access.
**HL7v2 to FHIR Transformation**: Seamlessly convert HL7v2 messages into FHIR-compliant resources.
**CCDA to FHIR Transformation**: Seamlessly convert CCDA documents into FHIR-compliant resources.
**Standardized Data Storage**: Store and manage healthcare data in a unified, scalable, and
FHIR-compliant format.
**PHI Anonymization**: Protect sensitive health data with built-in tools to anonymize personally
identifiable information (PII/PHI).
**Insights and Analytics**: Leverage machine learning models to generate actionable insights from
healthcare data.
**Health Information Exchange & Interoperability**: Subscribe to health resources across multiple
healthcare providers and receive real-time notifications on updates or changes.

# **OnyeOne API Documentation**[#][76]

The **OnyeOne API** provides a comprehensive interface to access, manage, and interact with
electronic health record (EHR) and electronic medical record (EMR) data. The API is designed to
support healthcare applications in ensuring interoperability, compliance with standards like FHIR,
and seamless integration into clinical workflows.

## **Key Features**[#][77]

**Patient Data Management**: Access and update patient demographics, medical history, and more.
**Appointment Management**: Schedule, update, and retrieve patient appointments, including details
such as date, time, provider, and location.
**Encounters**: Retrieve and manage patient encounters, including notes and diagnoses.
**Medications and Allergies**: Query prescribed medications, active allergies, and related details.
**Lab Results**: Retrieve lab orders, results, and observations.
**FHIR Compatibility**: Compliant with FHIR R4 specifications for enhanced interoperability.
**Secure Access**: OAuth 2.0-based authentication and role-based data access.
**HL7v2 to FHIR Transformation**: Seamlessly convert HL7v2 messages into FHIR-compliant resources.
**CCDA to FHIR Transformation**: Seamlessly convert CCDA documents into FHIR-compliant resources.
**Standardized Data Storage**: Store and manage healthcare data in a unified, scalable, and
FHIR-compliant format.
**PHI Anonymization**: Protect sensitive health data with built-in tools to anonymize personally
identifiable information (PII/PHI).
**Insights and Analytics**: Leverage machine learning models to generate actionable insights from
healthcare data.
**Health Information Exchange & Interoperability**: Subscribe to health resources across multiple
healthcare providers and receive real-time notifications on updates or changes.

## [Artificial Intelligence–Enabled Wearable Digital Phenotyping for Hemodialysis Vascular Access
## Monitoring: From Physical Examination to Home-Based Early Warning][112]

Hemodialysis vascular access is the lifeline of patients receiving maintenance hemodialysis, yet
access dysfunction remains a major cause of inadequate dialysis, repeated intervention, unplanned
catheter use, hospitalization, and eventual access loss. Current vascular access care relies on
physical examination, auscultation, dialysis-machine parameters, access-flow surveillance, duplex
ultrasound, and angiography. Although these approaches remain clinically indispensable, they are
episodic, operator-dependent, and poorly suited for continuous home-based warning. Recent advances
in artificial intelligence, digital auscultation, photoplethysmography, pulse radar sensing, soft
thermal sensors, wireless thrill sensors, ultrasound video analysis, and artificial intelligence of
things systems have created new opportunities to transform vascular access surveillance from
intermittent clinical assessment to continuous digital phenotyping. In this review, we propose a
framework for artificial intelligence–enabled vascular access monitoring organized around four
linked domains: pathophysiological signal generation, sensor-based digital phenotyping, artificial
intelligence–based risk inference, and clinically actionable home-based warning. We summarize recent
evidence from acoustic artificial intelligence, photoplethysmography-based classification, pulse
radar sensing, wearable thermal and vibration sensors, artificial intelligence–assisted ultrasound,
and multimodal clinical risk prediction models across the vascular access life cycle. We further
discuss key barriers to clinical translation, including inconsistent definitions of access
dysfunction, heterogeneous reference standards, small single-center datasets, limited external
validation, device usability, alert fatigue, workflow integration, regulatory requirements, and the
need for prospective outcome-based trials. Future studies should move beyond offline diagnostic
accuracy toward standardized external validation, longitudinal patient-specific baselines,
workflow-integrated monitoring systems, and prospective trials demonstrating reductions in
thrombosis, unplanned catheter placement, delayed intervention, access loss, and patient burden.

Our solution combines advanced remote monitoring and personalized support to enable early
intervention to improve health outcomes for high-risk individuals with complex diabetes.

## Introducing SmartMat+

[Learn about our next gen solution][24]

## From Feet to Full Health

We’re Your Partners in Complex Diabetes Care.

Over 37 million Americans live with diabetes, a condition that can cause severe, life-threatening
complications. Our solution focuses on diabetic foot health and extends to the broader unique health
challenges of people with diabetes. Central to our solution is the SmartMat™, a device that collects
key data for advanced remote monitoring and is supported by clinically validated methods and
personalized support. By empowering high-risk populations and enabling timely, targeted
interventions, we help reduce costs and achieve meaningful outcomes together.

  Identify individuals with complex diabetes who are at high risk for complications to intervene
  early and prevent avoidable complications.
* ### Lower Utilization
  ### and Costs
  
  Leverage advanced technology and a high-touch support program to reduce complications, ultimately
  lowering utilization and costs.
* ### Improve Health Outcomes
  
  Empower individuals with complex diabetes to lead independent and fulfilling lives, helping
  improve health outcomes.

[Our Solution][25]

## Avoid costly complications and improve overall health.

Diabetes complications can lead to mobility loss, decreased quality of life, increased risk of other
health issues, and higher costs for everyone.

**The solution? Clinically proven technology and proactive care with real results.**

The Podimetrics Program helps identify risks early, protect mobility, improve lives, and deliver
measurable ROI for your organization.^{1-4}

1 in 4 people living with diabetes will experience a foot ulcer in their lifetime.

7% of the population with diabetic foot ulcers accounts for thirty percent of all diabetes-related
spending.

One-third of all diabetes expenditures are spent on lower extremity complications.

85% of diabetic foot ulcers are preventable.

Support your most vulnerable members with an end-to-end solution.

### Grounded data

With clinically relevant, connected provider and patient data, our solutions bring the
interoperability, data rigor, and agentic-ready intelligence needed to make every interaction, and

### Dynamic intelligence

Smart engagement means knowing not just what to say, but when and how to say it. Our solutions guide
people toward the care and payment options that fits their needs – delivering the right action, at
the right moment, through the right channel.

## See it in action

RevSpring can simplify engagement, improve the patient financial experience, and deliver the results
that matter most to your team. Connect with us to learn more.

## What’s new at RevSpring

The latest thinking, announcements, and updates

 

### The Cost of Confusion in Healthcare

Healthcare shouldn’t feel this hard—but for most consumers, it still does. From finding care to
understanding costs and paying bills, confusion and friction are driving frustration, delaying
decisions, and even impacting whether patients seek care at all.

[Explore][86]

### From Acquisition to Action

At Becker’s Annual Meeting, Emory Healthcare joined RevSpring to explore how aligning scheduling,
financial experience, and communication can reduce friction, improve outcomes, and build lasting
patient trust.

[Explore][87]

### The “Now What” Era of Price Transparency

Brandon Spring, Chief Commercial Officer & Kyruus GM, took the stage at Becker’s Spring Payer Issues
Roundtable. His message was clear: healthcare has built the data—now it’s time to make it work for
the member experience.

## AI that knows healthcare

Most AI tools apply generic models to healthcare and call it innovation. RevSpring AI is different.
It is powered by proprietary data spanning the healthcare ecosystem, including provider and payer
networks, patient engagement, and payment behavior.

This intelligence is not scraped or inferred. It is sourced directly from the entities that own it,
creating an AI advantage that is specific, verifiable, and designed to get smarter over time.

## This is RevSpring

We combine human understanding with operational intelligence to guide every patient and member from
first touchpoint to final payment, making every interaction clearer, simpler, and more effective.

financial context to deliver personalized experiences that make each step of the healthcare journey
feel intentional and actionable.

every technology investment, work harder for your organization.

people toward the care and payment options that fits their needs – delivering the right action, at
the right moment, through the right channel.

that matter most to your team. Connect with us to learn more.

Sync everything

Fragmented data means missed signals. Sonar integrates all of your favorite apps and devices so you
can see the full picture.

## Understand Your Body in Real-Time

AI engines continuously discover subtle shifts and patterns that matter most across millions of data
points, helping you know when to push, when to pause, and where to focus next.

Start free trial

### Your AI Health Copilot

From energy and stress to sleep and nutrition, get deeply personalized coaching that helps you make
better decisions and build healthier habits.

See it in action

### Listen to Your Body's Battery

See how your energy levels shift throughout the day, so you can stay alert when it matters and
recover when it counts.

### Take Control Of Your Stress

Spot rising pressure early, understand your triggers, and take action before stress takes hold.

### Let Recovery Lead The Way

Gauge how ready you are to perform, avoid overtraining, and use daily recovery scores to guide your
next move.

### Sleep Deeper, Wake Stronger

Improve your sleep one night at a time by understanding how your sleep patterns shape your energy,
focus, and mood.

### Build the Foundations of Better Health

Get the fundamentals right today to build routines that lead to better performance, a longer
healthspan, and a happier, healthier you for years to come.

Check it out

### Better Nutrition Starts Here

Go beyond calorie counting. Learn to balance macros and time meals in the way that works best for
your body.

### Train Smarter, Not Harder

Get a clear view of your daily strain, workout intensity, and training load—so you can build fitness
sustainably.

## Take Your Health To The Big Screen

Give your health the space it deserves. From quick check-ins to deep dives, Sonar meets you wherever
you are across desktop, mobile, and your wrist.

Sign up[Desktop App]

Widgets

Elevate your home and lock screens with beautifully crafted widgets to fuel your daily routine.

[Widgets]

Putting privacy first

Privacy informs design

of that.

## Trusted by pros. Personalized to you.

From elite athletes to everyday achievers, join 250,000+ people using Sonar to fuel their
performance, longevity, and healthspan.

Ethan Runner

“Congrats on creating the app I've been looking for since I started training with different
trackers!”

“Finally an app that makes Apple and Garmin talk. Exactly what I'd been waiting for.”

Sarah T.

“I have to say this is incredible, intuitive and helpful.”

Kyle D.

“Love (love!) the app. As a longtime athlete who has vetted everything out there (and former Outside
magazine gear editor), I can tell you it's amazing.”

Laura B.

“I am overwhelmed in such a good way by your app and I'm not easily impressed! You have built an
amazing experience.”

Andreas J.

“I am AMAZED. Just wow. Thanks and kudos.”

Hans M.

“Like everyone else says, this is everything apple health wishes it was.”

TheHouseofIsp

“This is everything I wish Apple Health was - I love it.”

Emma J.

“Been using it a few weeks now, and I'm addicted to it. I love how nice the interface is, and very
easy to sync.”

Vegan_Lifter

“Sonar zeroed in on me daily - almost like the app knew who I was. Really, it was uncanny.”

Sr. Garza

“Syncing with other sources, wearables, and platforms - without a doubt, THE BEST. All the data
syncs and combines perfectly!!! No other app does this!”

James W.

“Long live the chosen one, and long live me with Sonar's help!”

### [ CAM ][70]

Leverage our SDKs to enable seamless collaboration cycles, from CAD design to the manufacturing shop
floor. Our SDKs — including ACIS, specifically developed for CAM — cover manufacturing workflows
from end to end so you can focus on the innovation required for on-demand manufacturing,
production-at-scale and Industry 4.0.

[https://10956.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/10956/_0000_AdobeStock_242124133-1.webp]
[slider arrow next]

### [ Robotics ][71]

Keep pace with the growing use of 3D models in manufacturing and the need for specialized software
applications to support complex machining operations. Use Spatial SDKs to develop custom 3D
applications that complement automated machinery, helping you achieve competitive differentiation.

[https://10956.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/10956/_0003_AdobeStock_335618324%20(1)-1.webp]
[slider arrow next]

### [ CAE ][72]

Our SDKs enable application developers to build integrated engineering simulation solutions,
facilitating accurate predictions of how product designs will behave in real-world environments.
Work with Spatial to reduce risk and benefit from accurate and reliable SDKs.

[https://10956.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/10956/_0004_AdobeStock_436459153-1.webp]
[slider arrow next]

### [ Metrology ][73]

Spatial’s 3D SDKs and APIs help application developers drive product advances by leveraging
industry-leading modeling, interoperability and visualization technology. Solve the problems of
shop-floor or inspection room users and drive higher quality and customer satisfaction levels.

[https://10956.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/10956/_0001_AdobeStock_260585643-1.webp]
[slider arrow next]

### [ Additive Manufacturing ][74]

Optimize your additive manufacturing workflows, facilitating seamless translation from precise and
polygonal models to your printer’s machine code and, ultimately, the final product. Perform all of
this while maintaining data integrity throughout the 3D model’s lifecycle.

[https://10956.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/10956/_0002_AdobeStock_225453042-1.webp]
[slider arrow next]

### [ BIM/AEC ][75]

Engineer virtual building solutions to enable better design, more predictable construction and
reduced operational costs. Use Spatial SDKs to execute several tasks including clash detection and
determining energy efficiency. Expand product innovation and enable collaboration between teams.

Benefit from our decades of experience as we assess, analyze and implement solutions that maximize

#### RIGHT PATIENT. RIGHT CARE SETTING. EVERY TIME.

# Move patients forward

Tennr is an agentic patient orchestration platform built for policy-grade decisioning and patient
flow at scale. Tennr helps providers navigate patients through complex payer requirements, countless
engagements, and every step in between.

[Learn More][9]

#### AT A GLANCE

## With Tennr, patients flow

Make intelligent operational decisions through every patient order, referral, or complex care
journey. Made possible by proprietary models trained on the largest dataset of service-to-payer
criteria mappings.

#### THE BOTTOM LINE

## No delays. Fewer denials. Optimal patient journeys.

Tennr intelligently processes and routes patients so high-performing healthcare operations can route
to the right care, in the right setting, every time.

### Move patients to the right places

Eliminate the operational friction that slows progression between consults, diagnostics,
authorizations, and scheduling.

### Slash first-pass denials

Turn a library of payer criteria into automatic operational decisions. Assemble proof, prioritize
care plans, and avoid revenue loss.

### Close the loop in care coordination

Coordinate patients, providers, and payers without endless manual follow-up calls or touch points.

[Explore the Product][10]

#### WHO WE WORK WITH

## Trusted nationwide

From national networks to independent providers, we power operations and millions of care pathways
each month.

#### KEEP PATIENTS MOVING

## Patient flow, optimized

Tennr keeps your patients moving through their care journeys without creating work for your team,
creating clarity and improving your cash flows at the same time.

Tennr automatically classifies and routes patient data from any source—fax, portal, internal
order—into the right operational workflows.

Wherever charts and orders need to reflect changes, they'll be automatically updated.

Tennr can check eligibility, investigate benefits over the phone, and submit prior authorizations.

Your patients' authorization status and medical necessity criteria will directly drive Tennr's
recommendations.

Finally, Tennr uses all of the data it touches to intelligently drive patient routing decisions,
unblock what’s stuck, and get you paid faster.

#### Testimonials

## What our customers say

They're improving quality, moving faster, and freeing up their teams. Here's what they have to say:

“With Tennr, we’re able to do things so much faster, and it's just huge. It’s been a game changer.
We’re able to reach out to patients so much faster.”

[Alyssa Jakubowski - Revenue Cycle and Compliance Manager at NEB Medical]

Alyssa Jakubowski
Revenue Cycle and Compliance Manager at NEB Medical

“I call it the 'Tennr effect.' For every action, there's a reaction. As we speed things up at the
front of the time, it's going to have downstream effects.”

Chip Holland
President of Total Sleep Management

Amy Willis

#### OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE AT SCALE

## Tennr sets a new standard for healthcare ops

Leading providers move faster, improve quality, and drive revenue with less effort.
[GET STARTED][11]
Patient data that flows on autopilot

Patient care starts with unstructured documentation. Tennr pulls data from faxes, charts, and
insurance plans faster than your best intake specialist, and can handle that volume without manual
intervention.

Information to complete every care journey

Missing documentation is the #1 reason patients stall. Tennr identifies what’s missing for the
specific patient and service, requests it from the right party, and tracks it through completion.



Intelligent insurance decisioning

Select the correct payer and plan every time. Identify coverage changes early. Re-verify patients
automatically. Tennr ensures active coverage is confirmed before care is scheduled.

Integrated payer interactions

No more hours and hours spent obtaining a successful prior authorization. We've got you covered for
all submissions and tracking across benefit types.

A control tower to route patients

See which patients are stuck. See what can move today. See what impacts value-based care. Tennr
provides real-time visibility into operational bottlenecks and prioritizes work that unlocks better
care and cash flow.

#### RIGHT PATIENT. RIGHT CARE SETTING. EVERY TIME.

# Move patients forward

Tennr is an agentic patient orchestration platform built for policy-grade decisioning and patient
flow at scale. Tennr helps providers navigate patients through complex payer requirements, countless
engagements, and every step in between.

[Learn More][9]

#### AT A GLANCE

## With Tennr, patients flow

Make intelligent operational decisions through every patient order, referral, or complex care
journey. Made possible by proprietary models trained on the largest dataset of service-to-payer
criteria mappings.

#### THE BOTTOM LINE

## No delays. Fewer denials. Optimal patient journeys.

Tennr intelligently processes and routes patients so high-performing healthcare operations can route
to the right care, in the right setting, every time.

### Move patients to the right places

Eliminate the operational friction that slows progression between consults, diagnostics,
authorizations, and scheduling.

### Slash first-pass denials

Turn a library of payer criteria into automatic operational decisions. Assemble proof, prioritize
care plans, and avoid revenue loss.

### Close the loop in care coordination

Coordinate patients, providers, and payers without endless manual follow-up calls or touch points.

[Explore the Product][10]

#### WHO WE WORK WITH

## Trusted nationwide

From national networks to independent providers, we power operations and millions of care pathways
each month.

#### KEEP PATIENTS MOVING

## Patient flow, optimized

Tennr keeps your patients moving through their care journeys without creating work for your team,
creating clarity and improving your cash flows at the same time.

Tennr automatically classifies and routes patient data from any source—fax, portal, internal
order—into the right operational workflows.

Wherever charts and orders need to reflect changes, they'll be automatically updated.

Tennr can check eligibility, investigate benefits over the phone, and submit prior authorizations.

Your patients' authorization status and medical necessity criteria will directly drive Tennr's
recommendations.

Finally, Tennr uses all of the data it touches to intelligently drive patient routing decisions,
unblock what’s stuck, and get you paid faster.

#### Testimonials

## What our customers say

They're improving quality, moving faster, and freeing up their teams. Here's what they have to say:

“With Tennr, we’re able to do things so much faster, and it's just huge. It’s been a game changer.
We’re able to reach out to patients so much faster.”

[Alyssa Jakubowski - Revenue Cycle and Compliance Manager at NEB Medical]

Alyssa Jakubowski
Revenue Cycle and Compliance Manager at NEB Medical

“I call it the 'Tennr effect.' For every action, there's a reaction. As we speed things up at the
front of the time, it's going to have downstream effects.”

[Chip Holland - President of Total Sleep Management]

Chip Holland
President of Total Sleep Management

“We hit 260 faxes in one day… and were able to manage it.”

[Amy Willis - Director of Complex Rehab at King Drug]

Amy Willis
Director of Complex Rehab at King Drug

#### OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE AT SCALE

## Tennr sets a new standard for healthcare ops

Leading providers move faster, improve quality, and drive revenue with less effort.
[GET STARTED][11]
Patient data that flows on autopilot

Patient care starts with unstructured documentation. Tennr pulls data from faxes, charts, and
insurance plans faster than your best intake specialist, and can handle that volume without manual
intervention.

Information to complete every care journey

Missing documentation is the #1 reason patients stall. Tennr identifies what’s missing for the
specific patient and service, requests it from the right party, and tracks it through completion.



Intelligent insurance decisioning

Select the correct payer and plan every time. Identify coverage changes early. Re-verify patients
automatically. Tennr ensures active coverage is confirmed before care is scheduled.

Integrated payer interactions

No more hours and hours spent obtaining a successful prior authorization. We've got you covered for
all submissions and tracking across benefit types.

A control tower to route patients

See which patients are stuck. See what can move today. See what impacts value-based care. Tennr
provides real-time visibility into operational bottlenecks and prioritizes work that unlocks better
care and cash flow.

## The patient management workflow

Curious what a day in the life of a clinician looks like in Welkin?

Manage patient care from diagnosis through ongoing treatment management.

#### Home

See your day at a glance. Home shows your schedule, tasks, unread communications and patient
escalations. This allows you to proactively plan your day and gives you the ability to swiftly react
to those who need attention.

#### Calendar

Schedule patient visits, encounters, or non-patient events, like team training. Multi-user views
show team availability and ensure shift coverage. The calendar API allows you to integrate your own
external calendars as well.

#### Patient Record

Customize and maintain comprehensive records of patients and their medical histories. Track
demographic information, vital signs, diagnoses, allergies, medication histories, treatment plans,
and lab results.

#### Assessments

Create assessments tailored to your program's needs and monitor patient progress at every stage of
care. Patient records and charts are updated real-time once responses are submitted and received.

Forms and assessments can be designed for scoring groups, conditionality, data charting and
reporting, and triggering automated program logic.

#### Encounters

Structure and template encounters to meet the requirements of your program making it easy for the
care team to navigate through patient visits systematically. Encounters include all necessary
information for successful insurance claims processing.
Hand

#### Labs and Imaging

Schedule laboratory tests and imaging procedures with over 110 lab vendors in the United States to
support your program's protocol. Lab results are received electronically, and care teams are
promptly notified when they are available for review.

#### ePrescribing

Effortlessly submit electronic prescriptions to your patients' chosen pharmacies. The Rcopia
e-prescribing system includes alerts for drug-drug interactions, drug-allergy interactions, dosing
errors, and duplicate therapies. It also provides patient-specific formulary guidance.

#### Document center

Streamlining the intake process is critical. Automate intake and consent forms ahead of a patient’s
visit or integrate Docusign for seamless signing. Upload any type of document to a patient profile
for record keeping including assessments, consent forms, licenses, medical records, or anything
else.

See your day at a glance. Home shows your schedule, tasks, unread communications and patient
escalations. This allows you to proactively plan your day and gives you the ability to swiftly react
to those who need attention.

#### Calendar

Schedule patient visits, encounters, or non-patient events, like team training. Multi-user views
show team availability and ensure shift coverage. The calendar API allows you to integrate your own
external calendars as well.

#### Patient Record

Customize and maintain comprehensive records of patients and their medical histories. Track
demographic information, vital signs, diagnoses, allergies, medication histories, treatment plans,
and lab results.

#### Assessments

Create assessments tailored to your program's needs and monitor patient progress at every stage of
care. Patient records and charts are updated real-time once responses are submitted and received.

Forms and assessments can be designed for scoring groups, conditionality, data charting and
reporting, and triggering automated program logic.

#### Encounters

Structure and template encounters to meet the requirements of your program making it easy for the
care team to navigate through patient visits systematically. Encounters include all necessary
information for successful insurance claims processing.

support your program's protocol. Lab results are received electronically, and care teams are
promptly notified when they are available for review.

e-prescribing system includes alerts for drug-drug interactions, drug-allergy interactions, dosing
errors, and duplicate therapies. It also provides patient-specific formulary guidance.

#### Document center

Streamlining the intake process is critical. Automate intake and consent forms ahead of a patient’s
visit or integrate Docusign for seamless signing. Upload any type of document to a patient profile
for record keeping including assessments, consent forms, licenses, medical records, or anything
else.

#### Tasks

Welkin enables smart task management and hand-offs by filling in the gaps, and prompting care team
members with tasks when they’re needed and for what. Coordinating care is simplified when tasks are
organized, are trackable, and can be shared or passed to other team members.

#### Insights

Data visualization informs your organization of program analytics across patient populations.
Surface actionable insights and identify trends around patient careflows, resource allocation,
assessment trends, and more. Review relevant datasets in Welkin or export data for external
consumption and analysis.

#### Communication

Direct and personal communication promotes plan adherence, retention — and ultimately, better
outcomes. Welkin’s multi-channel communication toolkit includes synchronous, HIPAA-compliant video
conferencing, or asynchronous secure email, web-based or patient-facing chat, SMS, and MMS.

SMS notifications for specific occurrences within the platform when something needs to be addressed
right away.

prevent, and resolve issues with ease. Real-time data reporting allows for immediate insights, and
versatile export capabilities provide complete control over your data.

Measure program performance for patients, service providers and payers. Track program progress and
iterate with pre-built or developing custom dashboards to manage your program.

plans, user experience by role, automations, alerts and notifications, tasks and communications.

the appropriate channels, and templatize communications as appropriate.

post-treatment billing. Automating key processes and integrating payer requirements, we help ensure
that claims are processed accurately and swiftly, alleviating the burden on your billing staff and
enhancing your practice’s efficiency.

Leverage analytics for your program to identify risks, understand the patient experience, review
program outcomes, and optimize operational efficiency. Leverage your data to drive unique and
meaningful insights for your program.

coaches interact with that information. To be able to go into a member record, see the information
in a timeline fashion and to act and react quickly really makes any member on our team able to
engage more effectively.

Heart failure affects 64.3 million people worldwide, and its prevalence jumped 46% from 1990 to 2017
even as modern trials showed major survival and hospitalization gains with today’s therapies,
including a 26% reduction in worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death with dapagliflozin. You
will also see how the global burden translates into 7.1 million deaths in 2017 and into tens of
billions in US and UK costs, alongside the latest guideline shift toward SGLT2 inhibitors for both
HFrEF and HFpEF.
