# Most AI rollouts die in month three. We build the ones that *don't*.

PromptMetrics helps teams build real AI fluency. Not another tool rollout, but the human skills and
the technical infrastructure that make AI actually work inside your organisation.

[Book a free call][19][See the First Skill Sprint →][20]

Discovery is free. We don't charge to find out whether we're a fit.

The moment

## You know the moment.

Someone above you said "we need to be doing AI." They looked at you because you're smart, and they
said: figure it out.

So now you're holding a mandate with no budget clarity, no technical co-pilot, no playbook, and a
deadline. You've watched the demos. None of it felt real, or built for how your team actually works.

That moment is the whole reason we exist, whether you got handed the mandate, you're a founder doing
the job of twelve, or you've already been burned by a tool that died in production.

What we actually do

## Two people. One human side, one technical side. That's the product.

Ranya is the human skills. Izzy is the technical infrastructure. PromptMetrics is what happens where
the two of them meet. Depending on what you need, we do one of three things, and we tell you which
in the first conversation.

Build it for you

We build the implementation: the connections, the skills that replace the manual work, the
governance layer with a human review step at every stage. Documented so any developer can maintain
it. Nothing is a black box.

Build it with you

We sit with your team, build the first workflow together, and leave you able to build the next one
without us. You keep the capability, not just the tool.

Figure out what to build

You have the mandate but no clarity on where to start. We give you a plan you can actually execute,
with what to build, in what order, for which team, not a slide deck you can't action.

The service ladder

## Start small. The first yes shouldn't feel like a gamble.

You don't have to bet the budget to find out if this works. Most people start with a Sprint, see the
result, and decide what's next from there.

Start here
First Skill Sprint
Let's talk

One workflow, turned into one governed skill, in one to two weeks. Fixed scope, fixed price. The
smallest real thing we can do that proves the point.

[See the Sprint →][21]
Flagship Pilot
Quote on scope

Five to ten operators, one workflow, four to six weeks. We measure your baseline before we touch
anything, then measure again after. You meet the price in conversation.

[How the Pilot works →][22]
AI Fluency Cohort
Let's talk

Live, Ranya-led. We teach the thinking skills that make AI work, for founders and operators who want
the fluency without a full build.

[See the cohort →][23]
No compromise

## The things we won't compromise on.

Four promises we can actually keep today.

### You stay in charge.

Every workflow has a human review step. Draft, then you review, never autonomous action. You are the
gate. Nothing goes out without you.

### Nothing is a black box.

The skills we build are markdown files. Any developer you ever hire can read them, change them, and
maintain them. You're never locked in to us.

### We measure before we touch anything.

We baseline your workflow, timed, not surveyed, before we build. Any number you hear is a hypothesis
we test together in your environment. You own the data.

### We stay until it works.

If HubSpot or Salesforce changes a field, we fix it. The hard part of AI isn't the build, it's the
change management. That's the part we don't leave.

Build in public

## Don't take our word for it. Read the code.

We can't show you a Fortune 500 logo wall, because we don't have one yet. So we show our work
instead. A free skill that does most of the job isn't a lost sale. It's the proof. We sell the part
a markdown file can't: the connection into your stack, the governance, the change management, and

## Based in Berlin. We don't pretend the EU questions away.

EU data residency, the DPA, no training on your data: real procurement questions, available at the
platform's enterprise tier. We'll tell you exactly where the gaps are rather than wave them away.

The EU AI Act starts enforcing high-risk rules on **August 2, 2026**, with penalties up to 3% of
global turnover. The governed, approval-gated, audit-trailed layer we build is the compliance
architecture.

[How it works, and what leaves the building →][27]

We're rebuilding PromptMetrics from scratch as of 2026, with no inherited product and no legacy
clients. We're looking for a small number of early customers who want to build this with us. If you
go first, you get our full attention and a price that reflects it. If you need someone else to have
gone first, we're not the right fit yet, and we'll say so.

## Tell us the thing that's actually broken.

Not the general AI opportunity. The specific workflow that costs you the most time or money right
now. If you can name it in a sentence, we can have a real conversation about it. The first call is
free, and it's a conversation, not a pitch.

[Book a free call →][28]
You'll talk to Ranya first. Izzy joins when it's time to go deep on the technical side.

So now you're holding a mandate with no budget clarity, no technical co-pilot, no playbook, and a
deadline. You've watched the demos. None of it felt real, or built for how your team actually works.

That moment is the whole reason we exist, whether you got handed the mandate, you're a founder doing
the job of twelve, or you've already been burned by a tool that died in production.

Ranya is the human skills. Izzy is the technical infrastructure. PromptMetrics is what happens where
the two of them meet. Depending on what you need, we do one of three things, and we tell you which
in the first conversation.

Build it for you

We build the implementation: the connections, the skills that replace the manual work, the
governance layer with a human review step at every stage. Documented so any developer can maintain
it. Nothing is a black box.

Build it with you

We sit with your team, build the first workflow together, and leave you able to build the next one
without us. You keep the capability, not just the tool.

Figure out what to build

You have the mandate but no clarity on where to start. We give you a plan you can actually execute,
with what to build, in what order, for which team, not a slide deck you can't action.

No compromise

## The things we won't compromise on.

Four promises we can actually keep today.

### You stay in charge.

Every workflow has a human review step. Draft, then you review, never autonomous action. You are the
gate. Nothing goes out without you.

### Nothing is a black box.

The skills we build are markdown files. Any developer you ever hire can read them, change them, and
maintain them. You're never locked in to us.

### We measure before we touch anything.

We baseline your workflow, timed, not surveyed, before we build. Any number you hear is a hypothesis
we test together in your environment. You own the data.

### We stay until it works.

If HubSpot or Salesforce changes a field, we fix it. The hard part of AI isn't the build, it's the
change management. That's the part we don't leave.

## Based in Berlin. We don't pretend the EU questions away.

EU data residency, the DPA, no training on your data: real procurement questions, available at the
platform's enterprise tier. We'll tell you exactly where the gaps are rather than wave them away.

The EU AI Act starts enforcing high-risk rules on **August 2, 2026**, with penalties up to 3% of
global turnover. The governed, approval-gated, audit-trailed layer we build is the compliance
architecture.

[How it works, and what leaves the building →][27]

We're rebuilding PromptMetrics from scratch as of 2026, with no inherited product and no legacy
clients. We're looking for a small number of early customers who want to build this with us. If you
go first, you get our full attention and a price that reflects it. If you need someone else to have
gone first, we're not the right fit yet, and we'll say so.
